evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic maxim that crystallizes a technical rule into a memorable chiasmus — plain-spoken in vocabulary but playful in construction, the document's register signature.

mints.name: RuleAsMatchedOpposition
mints.title: crystallize a rule into matched opposed clauses
mints.frame: Is the expression performing a rule as a balanced antithesis — the same terms turned against themselves — rather than stating it instrumentally?
